phase1.q: Your college team is building a major project for an all-India hackathon. Which part of the project do you naturally take charge of?

options.t: Designing and building the core application logic, APIs, and databases so everything runs reliably.
options.i: Solid engineering instinct, {name}! You naturally focus on core application architecture.

options.t: Training an intelligent model or analyzing datasets to give your project smart predictive capabilities.
options.i: Analytical mindset, {name}! You look for patterns and intelligence in data.

options.t: Crafting a beautiful, intuitive user interface in Figma and ensuring user flow is seamless.
options.i: Great user empathy, {name}! You prioritize user experience and visual interface design.

options.t: Setting up cloud hosting on AWS/GCP, Docker containers, and CI/CD pipelines so deployment never fails.
options.i: Infrastructure-first thinking, {name}! You ensure high availability and smooth deployments.

phase1.q: During a major online sale in India, the e-commerce backend experiences severe lag. What is your immediate diagnostic reaction?

options.t: Inspect server-side execution traces, database queries, and async code execution bottlenecks.
options.i: Deep troubleshooter, {name}! You jump right into code execution performance.

options.t: Analyze real-time event telemetry to understand drop-offs, user funnel anomalies, and anomaly alerts.
options.i: Data-driven approach, {name}! You look at system health through metrics and user data.

options.t: Redesign the checkout flow to gracefully inform users, queue traffic, and prevent cart abandonment frustration.
options.i: Product-first vision, {name}! You focus on preserving user trust during downtime.

options.t: Audit firewall traffic, auto-scaling worker groups, load balancers, and network ingress paths.
options.i: Resilience expert, {name}! You look at traffic routing, load balancers, and cloud infra capacity.

phase1.q: When exploring a new open-source repository on GitHub, what part of the repository pulls your interest first?

options.t: The clean directory layout, design patterns, object structures, and modular codebase logic.
options.i: Architecture focused, {name}! Clean modular code is your technical benchmark.

options.t: The data pipelines, PyTorch/TensorFlow scripts, data cleanups, and evaluation metrics.
options.i: AI-curious mind, {name}! Machine learning and data pipelines catch your eye instantly.

options.t: The frontend component library, design tokens, responsive CSS micro-animations, and UI components.
options.i: Eye for detail, {name}! Clean design tokens and frontend components excite you.

options.t: The Dockerfile, Kubernetes helm charts, Terraform infrastructure scripts, and GitHub workflow actions.
options.i: Automation pro, {name}! Infrastructure-as-code and container setups are your playground.

phase1.q: What type of technical problem feels most rewarding for you to solve after hours of effort?

options.t: Optimizing a slow API endpoint or database query from 2.5s down to 40ms.
options.i: Performance enthusiast, {name}! Speed and efficiency optimization drive your work.

options.t: Getting a machine learning model to reach 96% accuracy on a complex, messy real-world dataset.
options.i: Precision seeker, {name}! Extracting high accuracy from noisy datasets is your specialty.

options.t: Transforming a confusing 5-step user journey into a single, effortless 1-click action.
options.i: Simplicity champion, {name}! You turn complex user friction into elegant simple flows.

options.t: Automating zero-downtime rolling upgrades across a multi-region cloud cluster.
options.i: Reliability builder, {name}! High availability and seamless upgrades give you peace of mind.

phase1.q: If you were joining an early-stage Indian tech startup tomorrow, which core team would you want to sit with?

options.t: Core Product Engineering — shipping core features, scalable backends, and app capabilities.
options.i: Core builder, {name}! You thrive in product engineering teams building features.

options.t: AI & Insights Lab — building recommendation algorithms, GenAI features, and analytics engine.
options.i: Innovation driver, {name}! Building intelligent AI engines is where you shine.

options.t: Product & UX Studio — interviewing users, refining wireframes, and shaping product strategy.
options.i: Product strategist, {name}! Shaping vision and user experience is your calling.

options.t: DevOps & Cloud Ops — maintaining zero outage, cloud cost management, and security posture.
options.i: Foundation keeper, {name}! You keep the tech machinery running smoothly and securely.

phase1.q: Which emerging tech trend in 2026 gets you most eager to build something original?

options.t: Next-gen web stack: Server Actions, WebAssembly, high-throughput microservices, and edge computing.
options.i: Tech forward, {name}! Modern high-throughput application stacks excite you.

options.t: Autonomous AI agents, multimodal LLMs, RAG systems, and neural network fine-tuning.
options.i: AI frontier, {name}! Autonomous agents and LLM orchestration are your ambition.

options.t: Inclusive design, AI-powered spatial UI, cross-platform micro-interactions, and visual systems.
options.i: Design innovator, {name}! Spatial interfaces and micro-interactions spark your creativity.

options.t: Internal developer platforms, GitOps, AI-driven observability, and multi-cloud orchestration.
options.i: DevOps innovator, {name}! Developer platforms and automated orchestration captivate you.

phase1.q: How do you prefer to measure the success of a technology product you built?

options.t: Clean code coverage, low bug count, sub-second latency, and graceful error handling.
options.i: Quality focused, {name}! Robustness and clean code metrics are your benchmark.

options.t: F1-score, prediction accuracy, statistical significance, and actionable insights produced.
options.i: Metric driven, {name}! Quantitative precision and statistical impact define success for you.

options.t: High user engagement, Net Promoter Score (NPS), low bounce rates, and user delight.
options.i: User centric, {name}! User satisfaction and retention metrics are your measure of success.

options.t: 99.999% uptime SLA, zero unplanned downtime, fast incident recovery, and cloud cost efficiency.
options.i: SLA champion, {name}! Maximum uptime and cost-efficient cloud infra mean success to you.

phase1.q: If you had 2 weeks of free time to complete any self-guided project, what would you choose?

options.t: Build a complete SaaS platform with user authentication, payments, and live chat backend.
options.i: Product engine builder, {name}! Full-fledged SaaS applications are right up your alley.

options.t: Fine-tune an open-source LLM model on an Indian language dataset for domain-specific Q&A.
options.i: AI builder, {name}! Custom model fine-tuning and language AI inspire your projects.

options.t: Redesign the mobile app of your favorite Indian startup (e.g. Swiggy or Zomato) with fresh UI/UX concepts.
options.i: Creative UX thinker, {name}! Redesigning real-world consumer apps showcases your talent.

options.t: Build a self-hosting homelab cluster using Docker, Kubernetes, automated backups, and Cloudflare tunnels.
options.i: Homelab tinkerer, {name}! Self-hosted clusters and cloud automation show true DevOps passion.

systems.q: When building a web or mobile application, which domain of code do you find yourself enjoying most?

options.t: Frontend UI: Crafting responsive layouts, state management, animations, and component styling.
options.i: Frontend champion, {name}! Bringing pixel-perfect interfaces to life is your core strength.

options.t: Backend Logic: Building REST/GraphQL APIs, database queries, authentication pipelines, and server logic.
options.i: Backend architect, {name}! Server-side logic, performance, and databases are your sweet spot.

options.t: End-to-End Fullstack: Connecting database tables to APIs and rendering them directly in modern UI frameworks.
options.i: Fullstack versatile, {name}! Owning features from DB schema all the way to UI is your goal.

options.t: Mobile Native/Cross-Platform: Building smooth smartphone apps optimized for touch gestures and mobile OS APIs.
options.i: Mobile creator, {name}! Native or cross-platform smartphone experiences excite you.

systems.q: If you had to pick your primary backend programming ecosystem for the next 2 years, which philosophy matches yours?

options.t: JavaScript / TypeScript (Node.js, Express, Next.js) — Single language across frontend and backend.
options.i: TS ecosystem enthusiast, {name}! One language across fullstack simplifies development.

options.t: Java / Spring Boot or C# / .NET — Enterprise battle-tested reliability, strict typing, and large ecosystems.
options.i: Enterprise developer, {name}! Robust enterprise stacks like Spring Boot or .NET build solid tech careers.

options.t: Go (Golang) or Rust — High concurrency, low memory footprint, ultra-fast microservices, and systems programming.
options.i: Systems performance geek, {name}! Ultra-fast compiled languages give you supreme engineering control.

options.t: Python (FastAPI, Django) or PHP (Laravel) — Rapid development speed, clean code syntax, and quick iteration.
options.i: Rapid ship developer, {name}! High-velocity stacks like FastAPI or Laravel get MVPs out lightning fast.

systems.q: In mobile development, how do you approach building apps for both Android and iOS users in India?

options.t: Flutter (Dart) — Beautiful 60fps UI rendering engine, high performance, and single codebase.
options.i: Flutter advocate, {name}! Dart's UI engine gives you complete visual control across devices.

options.t: React Native / Expo (JavaScript/TypeScript) — Leveraging web React skills to ship native iOS and Android apps.
options.i: React Native strategist, {name}! Sharing React knowledge across web and mobile is super efficient.

options.t: Native Android (Kotlin / Jetpack Compose) — Deep integration with Android system services and hardware.
options.i: Android Specialist, {name}! Deep native Android mastery gives you unmatched device performance.

options.t: Native iOS (Swift / SwiftUI) — Premium Apple ecosystem integration, slick HIG guidelines, and iOS performance.
options.i: iOS Developer, {name}! SwiftUI and native iOS architecture craft high-end user experiences.

systems.q: How do you prefer handling API communication between frontend apps and backend servers?

data_ai.q: In the Data & AI landscape, which specific domain of data engineering or artificial intelligence attracts you most?

options.t: Machine Learning & Deep Learning: Training predictive models, classification, regression, and PyTorch experiments.
options.i: Core ML Engineer, {name}! Building and fine-tuning predictive neural networks is your passion.

options.t: Generative AI & LLMs: Building RAG apps, prompt workflows, fine-tuning open LLMs, and AI agent frameworks.
options.i: GenAI Pioneer, {name}! LLMs, RAG pipelines, and autonomous AI agents are the future you want to build.

options.t: Data Engineering & Pipelines: Building scalable ETL/ELT pipelines with Apache Spark, Kafka, and Snowflake/BigQuery.
options.i: Data Pipeline Architect, {name}! High-volume data flows and warehouse transformations are your domain.

options.t: Computer Vision or Speech AI: Processing images, video feeds, OCR, object detection, or speech-to-text models.
options.i: Perceptual AI Specialist, {name}! Teaching computers to see and hear world inputs is fascinating.

data_ai.q: How do you prefer working with datasets and AI models day-to-day?

options.t: Data Analytics & Storytelling: Querying SQL, analyzing trends in Pandas, and building executive dashboards.
options.i: Data Analyst & Storyteller, {name}! Translating raw business numbers into strategic insights is powerful.

options.t: Statistical Modeling & Research: Formulating hypotheses, feature engineering, and testing advanced math models.
options.i: Data Scientist, {name}! Rigorous statistics and algorithmic experimentation drive your career.

options.t: MLOps & Model Deployment: Containerizing models, CI/CD for AI, monitoring drift, and serving inference APIs.

cloud_infra.q: Within cloud computing and infrastructure engineering, which path aligns best with your career ambitions?

options.t: DevOps & CI/CD Pipelines: Automating build triggers, Docker containers, automated testing, and deployments.
options.i: DevOps Specialist, {name}! Streamlined deployment pipelines and container automation are your specialty.

options.t: Cloud Architecture (AWS / Azure / GCP): Designing multi-tier cloud topology, VPCs, IAM policies, and serverless architectures.
options.i: Cloud Architect, {name}! Structuring enterprise cloud infrastructure topologies is your long-term target.

options.t: Site Reliability Engineering (SRE): Managing uptime SLAs, incident response, error budgets, and chaos engineering.
options.i: SRE Specialist, {name}! Keeping mission-critical high-traffic infrastructure online with 99.999% reliability is your calling.

options.t: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) & Kubernetes: Writing declarative HCL infrastructure and managing K8s clusters.
options.i: IaC & Kubernetes Expert, {name}! Declarative infrastructure scripts and container orchestration are your superpower.

cloud_infra.q: How do you prefer approaching server management and developer infrastructure?

options.t: Internal Developer Platforms (IDP): Building self-service portals (like Backstage) for developer teams.
options.i: Platform Engineer, {name}! Building golden paths and self-service portals empowers developer velocity.

options.t: Cloud Cost Optimization (FinOps): Analyzing AWS bills, right-sizing EC2/K8s instances, and managing cloud budgets.
options.i: FinOps Engineer, {name}! Optimizing massive cloud expenditure saves tech companies millions.

options.t: Linux System Administration & Networking: Deep CLI bash scripting, systemd, SSH hardening, and subnet routing.
options.i: System Administrator, {name}! Deep Linux shell scripting and core networking are timeless skills.

options.t: Observability & Telemetry: Setting up OpenTelemetry, Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, and distributed tracing.
options.i: Observability Engineer, {name}! Full-stack visibility with metrics, logs, and distributed traces makes you invaluable.

operations.q: If you were working in specialized tech domains outside traditional web/app dev, which area excites you most?

options.t: Game Development (Unity / Unreal Engine / C# / C++): Building 3D physics, game loops, shaders, and interactive worlds.
options.i: Game Developer, {name}! Crafting 3D game engines, shaders, and interactive virtual worlds is your dream.

options.t: Embedded Systems, IoT & Robotics: Writing firmware, microcontrollers (Arduino/ESP32), ROS2, and hardware robotics.
options.i: Robotics & Hardware Specialist, {name}! Blending hardware microcontrollers with software code is true engineering.

options.t: Blockchain & Web3 (Solidity, Smart Contracts): Building decentralized apps (dApps), Ethereum smart contracts, and Web3 tech.
options.i: Web3 & Smart Contract Developer, {name}! Decentralized ledgers and Solidity smart contracts are your focus.

options.t: AR/VR & Spatial Computing: Building immersive Augmented/Virtual Reality apps using WebXR or Unity/Unreal.
options.i: AR/VR Innovator, {name}! Immersive spatial computing and 3D experiences represent your visual vision.

operations.q: How about specialized business tech, automation, or technical communications?

options.t: QA Test Automation (Playwright, Selenium, SDET): Writing automated end-to-end test suites for enterprise software.
options.i: QA & SDET Engineer, {name}! Automated test suites and bulletproof quality assurance protect product releases.

options.t: No-Code / Low-Code & Enterprise Platforms: Building solutions rapidly using Salesforce, Shopify, WordPress, or RPA tools.
options.i: Enterprise Platform Specialist, {name}! Rapid ecosystem platforms like Salesforce or Shopify drive business digital workflows.

options.t: Technical Writing & Developer Docs: Authoring API documentation, developer guides, and architectural whitepapers.
options.i: Technical Writer, {name}! Clear technical documentation and developer guides empower global software communities.

options.t: Digital Marketing & SEO Analytics: Technical SEO audits, GA4 event tracking, performance marketing, and conversion funnels.
options.i: SEO & Growth Analyst, {name}! Combining technical web optimization with growth analytics drives massive audience traffic.

systems.q: In an enterprise software project, which engineering trade-off matters most to your technical principles?

options.t: Clean modular code architecture that is testable and easy for junior devs to read.
options.i: Architectural purity, {name}! Maintainable code bases save team overhead.

options.t: Pixel-perfect UI animations and smooth client-side performance.
options.i: UI craftsmanship, {name}! Delighting users with slick frontend performance is key.

options.t: Fast API response times under high concurrent user traffic load.
options.i: Performance focus, {name}! Low-latency API response times are your engineering pride.

options.t: Cross-platform consistency across iOS, Android, and Desktop environments.
options.i: Multi-platform reach, {name}! Universal software delivery across devices is essential.

data_ai.q: When deploying artificial intelligence into production, what is your top operational priority?

options.t: Model accuracy, low hallucination rates, and high precision metrics.
options.i: Model quality advocate, {name}! High accuracy and trustworthy outputs matter most.

options.t: Low latency inference speed and GPU cost efficiency.
options.i: Inference efficiency pro, {name}! Fast response times and GPU cost management drive real-world AI.

options.t: Clean automated data pipelines with zero data corruption.
options.i: Data pipeline guardian, {name}! Reliable data ingestion makes AI models trustworthy.

options.t: Clear data visualizations and executive dashboard reports.
options.i: Insight communicator, {name}! Transforming complex data into actionable leadership dashboards is powerful.

design_product.q: What defines a truly successful digital product in your eyes?

options.t: Users intuitively understand how to use it without reading any documentation.
options.i: Frictionless UI believer, {name}! Intuitive self-explanatory interface design is true excellence.

options.t: Strong business metrics, high user retention, and sustainable monetisation.
options.i: Product strategist, {name}! Business metrics and customer retention build enduring startups.

options.t: Consistent design tokens, typography, and reusable component systems.
options.i: Design system advocate, {name}! Structured design tokens and component standards create visual harmony.

options.t: Deep qualitative alignment with real user needs uncovered through research.
options.i: User-first researcher, {name}! Deep qualitative user discovery prevents building the wrong features.

cloud_infra.q: What gives you the greatest peace of mind when managing cloud infrastructure?

options.t: Zero downtime during deployment rollouts with instant automated rollback capability.
options.i: Deployment safety expert, {name}! Instant automated rollbacks make releases stress-free.

options.t: Declarative Infrastructure-as-Code where everything can be recreated with one command.
options.i: IaC champion, {name}! Reproducible declarative cloud state eliminates configuration drift.

options.t: Comprehensive Grafana metrics dashboards with active anomaly alerting.
options.i: Observability pro, {name}! Real-time telemetry dashboards keep you aware of system health.

options.t: Optimized cloud billing with no wasted EC2/K8s resource capacity.
options.i: Cloud cost optimizer, {name}! Efficient resource allocation keeps cloud bills lean and clean.

security.q: What is your primary philosophy when securing enterprise tech systems?

options.t: Shift-left security: Catching code vulnerabilities in CI/CD before code ever reaches production.
options.i: Shift-left advocate, {name}! Automated static analysis in pipelines stops bugs early.

options.t: Continuous offensive testing: Simulating attacker exploits to verify real vulnerabilities.
options.i: Adversary simulator, {name}! Offensive ethical hacking reveals true security gaps.

options.t: Zero-Trust architecture & strict Identity Access Management (IAM) controls.
options.i: Zero-Trust architect, {name}! Strict identity validation and minimum privilege access safeguard data.

options.t: Real-time threat monitoring and rapid digital forensics incident response.
options.i: Threat responder, {name}! Vigilant SOC monitoring and fast incident response limit damage.

operations.q: In specialized technology operations, what outcome is most satisfying?

options.t: Shipping a flawless automated test suite with 100% regression pass rates.
options.i: Automation master, {name}! Automated test suites guarantee software reliability.

options.t: Publishing a clear, comprehensive API documentation portal that developers praise.
options.i: Tech communicator, {name}! World-class documentation empowers global developer communities.

options.t: Building a immersive 3D interactive game or VR experience with smooth frame rates.
options.i: 3D Creator, {name}! High-performance interactive worlds deliver pure user immersion.

options.t: Automating repetitive enterprise business workflows with low-code/RPA tools.
options.i: Workflow automator, {name}! Removing manual business work with low-code automation drives huge efficiency.

options.t: Deep Focus Coding: Extended uninterrupted blocks of writing clean code, building features, and refactoring.
options.i: Deep builder, {name}! Deep focus sessions and shipping clean code are your natural workflow.

options.t: Data & Model Experimentation: Working in notebooks, testing algorithms, and tweaking parameters iteratively.
options.i: Iterative experimenter, {name}! Hypothesis testing and model tweaking suit your analytical rhythm.

options.t: Cross-Functional Collaboration: Meeting with design, product, engineering leads, and business stakeholders.
options.i: Collaborative leader, {name}! Aligning teams and bridging tech with business vision is your strength.

options.t: Systems & Security Operations: Monitoring dashboards, automating infra scripts, and responding to incidents.
